extract_dsa_nodes: extract specified DSA nodes and their edges from a dot file to an output file
filter_dot_edges: filter dot file edges to keep only those between specified node sets
search_dsa_nodes: search a DSA dot file for nodes matching given substring patterns
build_dsa_extractor: build a two-pass DSA dot file extractor that filters nodes and edges by name
run_dsaextract_cli: run the DSAextract CLI tool to extract named nodes from a dot file
